about: Household student-loan debt for the student-loan debt kind (pool item laws-federal-student-loan-debt-kind): who holds it, how much, by age. Not read by an engine yet. studentaid.gov and its Internet Archive copies refused every fetch, so the Federal Student Aid portfolio (borrower counts, repayment status, monthly payments) is NOT in this file; those figures stay a research need and the engine must mark any it uses ESTIMATED. Real totals check the simulation; they never decide whether one household owes.

nyFed.note: Federal and private student loans are not separated.

balanceByAgeTrillionUsd.note: The published total is 1.651; the NY Fed notes a small number of unknown birth years.

balanceShareByAgePct.method: Each age row over the sum of the age rows (1.6447).
